first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The foreground person on the image-left, with a short buzz cut, wearing a dark zip-up jacket with a light-colored garment visible inside the raised collar.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The foreground person on the image-right, wearing a dark brimmed soft hat, a loose leather-like coat with thick dark lapels, and a light-colored turtleneck top; in the latter part, their right arm rests on the railing.

entities.name: multistory buildings along the street
entities.identification: Continuous multistory buildings on both sides of the road, with rows of windows, balcony railings, pitched roofs, and rooftop signs; a spire silhouette is visible in the central distance.

entities.name: city road and intersection
entities.identification: The horizontal road in the lower part, the longitudinal road converging into the distance at the center, and their intersection.

entities.name: trees along the street
entities.identification: Groups of trees in front of the buildings on both sides of the road, with dim gray irregular crowns and branching trunks and limbs.

entities.name: overcast sky
entities.identification: The light gray sky above the buildings and in the central gap, with alternating darker and lighter cloud-layer textures.

entities.name: cars on the road
entities.identification: Multiple low cars on the horizontal road and the road extending into depth, treated collectively as a background group of vehicles.

entities.name: long-bodied bus on the road
entities.identification: Multiple light-colored long-bodied buses at the intersection, with dark window bands and rows of windowpanes along their sides.

entities.name: dark metal railing
entities.identification: The dark railing behind the people, with a straight, thick horizontal top rail and portions of vertical posts visible.

entities.name: parapet end post
entities.identification: The light gray square post in the lower-right corner of the initial image, with a tiered support at the top and a dark domed cap.

entities.name: pedestrians at the street intersection
entities.identification: The group of distant pedestrians at the intersection and in pedestrian areas along the street, excluding Person A and Person B.

entities.name: streetlights along the street
entities.identification: The slender lamp poles at the intersection and on both sides of the road, topped with round or projecting lamp heads.

entities.name: traffic light at the intersection
entities.identification: The vertically stacked signal-light housings on a pole at the intersection, with parts of their sides appearing light-colored.
